# truenas_service (Resource)

Manages a TrueNAS service (enable/disable, start/stop). Services are not created or deleted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_service" "nfs" {
  name    = "nfs"
  enabled = true
  running = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Service name: nfs, cifs, ssh, ftp, iscsitarget, snmp, ups, nvmet, webshare.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the service starts automatically on boot.
- `running` (Boolean) Whether the service is currently running. Set to true to start, false to stop.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Service name (used as Terraform ID).
